answer: An agent may issue at most one onboarding voucher per epoch, and that voucher can admit only a single newcomer. The sponsor must lock timber collateral equal to the newcomer's starting weight; the lock cannot move until the sponsee has survived a full tide of peer attestations. A public lantern lists every voucher so fan-out from one operator is visible on-chain. If clustering later marks the newcomer as a replica, both the voucher and the sponsor's collateral are slashed, so buying a crowd of identities costs more than honest mining.
